releaseNotes: CRITICAL installer fix: on a fresh PC the previous Stable installer could refuse to install with 'Elmashad could not verify the latest release. Connect to the internet to continue.' even with a working internet connection. This is fixed.
The installer now always installs the bundled Elmashad release, online or offline; the latest-release check is best-effort and can no longer block a fresh installation.
VSTO runtime is still detected and installed automatically when missing.
Anti-downgrade protection is unchanged: an older installer still refuses to overwrite a newer installed Elmashad.
If a newer Stable exists online, the installer can resolve, verify and apply it after the base install.
Release pipeline now executes the exact public installer on a fresh machine with the latest endpoint offline before every publication (blocking gate).
No feature changes in this release: identical 0.3.1 product behavior with a working installer.
